This week, I will be touring Pennsylvania to meet with workers and communities and lay out a plan for a New Economic Patriotism. We need the future economy working not just for a few, but for all of us.

For our first stop, I joined @chrisrabb in Philadelphia to discuss a New Deal for the 21st century.
posts.summary: Advocates economic policy benefiting workers and communities, not wealthy few

posts.text:
At the heart of our founding was the belief that citizens must be economically independent to be free.

I spoke to Pennsylvanians about a New Economic Patriotism to make our highest mission the economic independence of every American family in every community.

My full remarks: open.substack.com/pub/rokhan…
posts.summary: Promotes economic independence for all American families as core value

posts.text:
Elected officials should not use campaign contributions to fight sexual misconduct allegations. 

Now more than ever, people are demanding transparency from our leaders. I am working across the aisle with @realannapaulina to ensure we obtain it.
posts.summary: Opposes campaign funds used for legal defense in misconduct cases

posts.text:
I stood on the picket line with frontline healthcare workers from Mount Nittany Medical Center to fight for a fair contract in which wages keep up with inflation. 

It is cruel that the hospital has taken away workers' health insurance to punish them for striking.
posts.summary: Supports healthcare workers' strike for fair wages and benefits

American families are paying $3500 more a year because of Trump’s war in Iran, his blanket tariffs, and his tax breaks for the wealthy.

We need Democrats back in power.
posts.summary: Criticizes Trump tariffs and tax policy, calls for Democratic return to power

posts.text:
In Allentown, I spoke with Mack Truck Workers from UAW of Local 677 in Lehigh Valley.

Mack is moving jobs to Mexico, where up to 49% of workers could lose their jobs. 

We must end taxpayer subsidized federal contracts to MAC to stop them from moving and tax offshoring. We need to close the loopholes in USMCA that allow them to import trucks from Mexico with enough US content and avoid tariffs.
posts.summary: Opposes corporate job offshoring, demands end to federal subsidies for contractors moving jobs abroad
